name: vscode-sugar
description: Live warrant / unsat diagnostics in the editor via sugar-linkerd. Slice A of #3774: one red squiggle, end to end.

sugar.linkerd.socketPath.description: Unix socket path for a sugar-linkerd daemon. If empty, one is derived under the OS temp dir per workspace.

sugar.linkerd.binaryPath.description: Absolute path to the sugar-linkerd binary. If set and the socket is not already live, the extension spawns the daemon. Resolve it with `bin/sugarbin --bin sugar-linkerd`.

sugar.debounceMs.description: Debounce window for re-linking on keystrokes.

sugar.prove.binaryPath.description: Absolute path to the `sugar` binary used to run `sugar prove --json` on a consumer project and paint UNSAT assertions as red squiggles. Resolve it with `bin/sugarbin`. If empty, the prove-path (native-assertion-vs-vendor-proof) is disabled.

sugar.prove.onSave.description: Run the PROVE path (full `sugar prove` on the consumer project) on save rather than on every keystroke. A directory prove mints + solves, so per-keystroke is too slow; on-save keeps the flip live without thrashing.

sugar.prove.timingLog.description: Path to a JSONL file the LSP prove path writes per-step timing to (mint / prove / paint durations, with a per-pass total). If empty, defaults to `<workspace>/.sugar/lsp-timing.jsonl`. Timings are mirrored live to the "Sugar Timing" output channel.

sugar.prove.pythonBinDir.description: Prepended onto PATH before running `sugar mint`/`sugar prove` for a python consumer project.

sugar.prove.pythonPath.description: Prepended onto PYTHONPATH before running `sugar mint`/`sugar prove` for a python consumer project (the sugar kit's importable src roots).

sugar.prove.rustBinDir.description: Prepended onto PATH before running `sugar mint`/`sugar prove` for a rust consumer project. Usually unnecessary: a rust consumer project that ships its own `.sugar/components/*/manifest.toml` (sugarbin-resolved absolute paths to the rust-test-assertions / rust-cargo-test-witness lifter binaries) is discovered by `sugar-cli` without any extra env, since component discovery walks the project root and its ancestors. Set this only when cargo/rustc or the helper RPC binaries are not already resolvable.
